 The actor behind Jason in 'GTA 6' has finally been revealed. Here's where you've seen him before.
 Dylan Rourke, who has appeared on "Grey's Anatomy" and "Modern Family," plays one of the two leads in "Grand Theft Auto VI."
 Tom Parfitt Follow SEO Editor, Yahoo UK Updated Thu, November 19, 2026 at 3:41 PM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Updated Thu, November 19, 2026 at 3:41 PM UTC Dylan Rourke voices Jason Duval in Grand Theft Auto VI . (Rockstar Games) One of the biggest mysteries surrounding Grand Theft Auto VI has finally been solved.
 Dylan Rourke is the actor behind Jason Duval, one of the two main characters in the year's most anticipated video game , as confirmed by the credits .
 Jason is one half of the crime saga's central couple, alongside his girlfriend, Lucia Caminos, voiced by Manni L. Perez . The pair are outlaws navigating the underworld of Vice City, a fictional version of Miami, where they become caught up in a larger conspiracy.
 Advertisement Advertisement Rockstar Games, the company behind GTA 6, kept the identities of the game's main performers under wraps until launch day, leaving fans to scour trailers for clues about who might be playing Jason and Lucia.
 In a joint Instagram post , Rourke and Perez said they were "truly honored to collaborate on this worldwide testament to human creativity, ingenuity, and sheer willpower."
 For Rourke, it's his most high-profile role after years of smaller parts in television, independent movies and theater. Here's what you need to know about him.
 Who is Dylan Rourke?
 Rourke has spent much of his career making guest appearances on television shows, including Grey's Anatomy , Modern Family , Timeless and Mistresses . He also appeared in the firefighter drama Station 19 and the procedural drama 9-1-1: Lone Star .
 Advertisement Advertisement His film credits include the 2023 horror movie Bury the Bride and the 2021 comedy Send It! 
 Rourke has also worked onstage. In 2019, he played Happy Loman in a production of Arthur Miller's Death of a Salesman at the Ruskin Group Theatre in Santa Monica, Calif.
 Jason is one of the game's two main characters.
 (Rockstar Games) According to his professional résumé , Rourke trained at three well-known improvisational comedy institutions: the Groundlings, Second City and Upright Citizens Brigade.
 He also performed with the late Fred Willard, the beloved comedian known for Best in Show , Anchorman and Modern Family . Rourke lists himself as an actor and writer with Willard's MoHos sketch-comedy troupe.
 Who else is in the GTA 6 cast?
 Manni L. Perez, who has appeared in Jessica Jones and Law & Order: Special Victims Unit , plays Lucia Caminos, Jason's girlfriend and the game's other playable protagonist. Her character is a former prison inmate determined to build a better life.
 Advertisement Advertisement Stephen Root, the veteran actor known for Office Space , Barry and King of the Hill , plays Brian Heder, a drug smuggler. Other recognizable names in the cast include Saturday Night Live alum Bobby Moynihan, who plays Jason's friend Cal, and Orange Is the New Black actor Taryn Manning, who voices Vicki.
 Musicians Lana Del Rey, Bad Bunny, Morgan Wallen, Burna Boy and Robyn also appear as hosts on the game's fictional radio stations.
